prompts.title: One specific thank-you
prompts.body: Tell each other one specific thing you appreciated about what just happened. Name it concretely — the action, the moment, the way it felt.

prompts.title: What you noticed I tried
prompts.body: Each of you name one thing you noticed the other person trying to do — not the result, the effort.

prompts.title: Thank you for trusting me with this
prompts.body: Say out loud that you trusted each other, and that you're grateful the other person showed up for the experiment.

prompts.title: Favorite moment of the loop
prompts.body: Each name a favorite moment from what just happened — the silliest, the most tender, the most surprising. Don't rank.

prompts.title: One thing I want more of
prompts.body: Each of you name one tiny thing from this loop you'd like more of in our regular life. Frame it as a wish, not a critique.

prompts.title: Thank you for the effort
prompts.body: Look each other in the eye. Say thank you for the effort. Let it land — count to three before saying anything else.

prompts.title: Something easy I loved
prompts.body: Each share one thing that felt easy or natural in the loop. Notice it. Let it count.

prompts.title: The after-photo, in words
prompts.body: Describe to each other, in one sentence, the version of the two of you that just walked out of that loop. Hold that picture for a moment.

prompts.title: Let it soak
prompts.body: Sit together quietly for thirty seconds. Don't talk. Don't reach for the phone. Just stay with each other and let the loop finish landing.

prompts.title: A one-line thank-you note
prompts.body: Each write a single sentence on paper or in a note to your partner. Hand it over. They read it without responding right away.
